title: Section 2: what do I do?
question: How does a stranger see the three steps, from one photo to sold, in the real app?
purpose: Ben, 10:05: one part at a time, options with how each looks and why. The hero says what it is; this section proves it with the app's own screens (W3, W15 phone frame).

variants.label: A. The scroll: one step per screen, the phone stays and its screen changes
B. One screen: three steps beside one phone
C. Three phones in a row, a step under each
